sources.title: French Interior Ministry: overseas visas
sources.publisher: French Ministry of the Interior, Directorate-General for Foreign Nationals
sources.officialityEvidence: The French Interior Ministry's current guidance identifies the territory-specific entry orders and explains that Schengen rules apply only to European France.
sources.supportingExcerpt: des arrêtés spécifiques à chaque collectivité ou territoire d'outre-mer

sources.title: France-Visas: short-stay visas for non-European French territories
sources.publisher: France-Visas, Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs
sources.officialityEvidence: France-Visas identifies itself as the official French visa website and directs nationality waivers for overseas territories to the relevant ministerial orders.
sources.supportingExcerpt: a Schengen visa will not allow you entry

sources.title: Current Annex II: Guadeloupe, French Guiana, Martinique and Réunion entry visas
sources.jurisdiction: France / Guadeloupe / French Guiana / Martinique / Réunion
sources.officialityEvidence: Légifrance publishes the current consolidated DROM Annex II, in force from 19 June 2025 after the 28 May 2025 amendment.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Version en vigueur depuis le 19 juin 2025

sources.title: Current Annex II: Mayotte entry visas
sources.officialityEvidence: Légifrance publishes the current consolidated Mayotte Annex II, in force from 19 June 2025 after the 28 May 2025 amendment.
sources.supportingExcerpt: dispensés de visa pour entrer sur le territoire de Mayotte

sources.title: Order of 29 December 2011: entry documents and visas for French Polynesia
sources.officialityEvidence: Légifrance publishes the current consolidated French Polynesia entry-document order and its Annex II nationality conditions.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Sont dispensés du visa prévu à l'article 1er les étrangers mentionnés à l'annexe II.

sources.title: Order of 22 July 2011: entry documents and visas for New Caledonia
sources.officialityEvidence: Légifrance publishes the current consolidated New Caledonia entry-document order and its Annex II nationality conditions.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Sont dispensés du visa prévu à l'article 1er les étrangers mentionnés à l'annexe II.
